verdict.rationale: ELSTER is an online service that stores users' tax data, receipts and documents, so whether that data can be kept out of AI model training is a fair privacy question for it. The evidence pack contains nothing about AI training, data-use policies or opt-out controls; it covers only filing, certificates, document uploads and the MeinELSTER+ app.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
